items.item_text: 01. Do you possess a Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, Higher Education Administration, Public Administration, or a closely related field? Options: Yes | No

02. Do you have at least five (5) years of progressively responsible experience in financial planning, budgeting, financial analysis, academic administration, higher education administration, or a closely related field? Options: Yes | No
03. Do you have demonstrated experience developing, managing, monitoring, and forecasting organizational budgets? Options: Yes | No
04. Do you have experience leading financial operations, including establishing or maintaining financial processes, controls, reporting practices, and accountability? Options: Yes | No
05. Are you proficient with spreadsheets, financial reporting, database, and related administrative systems? Options: Yes | No
